title: THE RED ROOM
message: You were not supposed to know this room existed.
meaning:
The Red Room is something that existed before you discovered it.

Nothing inside is necessarily dangerous. The unsettling part is that the room was hidden deliberately — and that the rest of the world continued normally while it remained unseen.

Discovery does not explain intention.
imageAlt: A concealed room visible through an open carved doorway in a dark corridor
mechanic: Hidden progression RARE. It does not enter the eligible pool until both THE BOOK and THE VEIL have been observed, then permanently opens the RED_ROOM branch.
